data.name: Ezechiel
data.gender_notes: Ezechiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God will strengthen, help; Yahweh is strong. In the Bible, Ezekiel is a prophet who receives a vision from God and delivers messages to the Israelites. The name Ezechiel carries the meaning “God will strengthen” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ezechiel usually hope their child will grow to embody god will strengthen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouragement, strength, and guidance from God.
data.etymology: Ezechiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God will strengthen.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ezechiel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אֵיכָאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אֵיכָאֵל, שֵם הַמֶּלֶךְ, גָּדוֹל, אֱלֹהִים. זהו שם הגדול, שהוא מלך ואלוהים. נזכר בספר ישעיה, כעין 40, 2. בעברית קדומה, השם מציין כוח, גדולה ועליונות. קשור לשם האלוהי, אל, ולביטוי, אלוה. במסורת הנוצרית, איכאל נזכר כאחד מהעצורים, האלוהיים.

in_greek.name: Ιεζεκιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: ὁ Ιεζεκιήλ, ὁ βασιλεύς, ὁ μεγάλης δύναμης Θεός. Ὁ ὄνομα τοῦ μεγάλου βασιλέως Θεοῦ. Ἀναφέρεται στο βιβλίο του Ιεζεκιήλ. Στη Βιβλική Εγκυκλοπαίδεια, ὁ Ιεζεκιήλ ἔχει ἀπὸ τὴν ἀρχαιοτάτη ἐποχή, ὡς καρπός τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος.

in_latin.name: Ezechiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Ezechiel, rex magnus, Deus potentissimus, qui in libro prophetae Ezechielis narratur. In antiquo, significat potestatem, magnitudinem, et divinitatem. In Ecclesia, Ezechiel est unus ex prophetis, qui Deum significat.

in_english.name: Ezechiel
in_english.meaning: God's powerful ruler, great king, mighty God
in_english.long_meaning: Ezechiel is a name that signifies God's power, greatness, and divinity. In the Bible, it is mentioned in the book of Ezekiel. In the Christian tradition, Ezechiel is one of the prophets who represents God. The name is associated with strength, greatness, and spirituality. It is a popular name among Christians, especially in the context of the Old Testament prophets.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ezechiel has its roots deeply planted in Judeo-Christian tradition. Ezechiel plays a significant role as one of the major prophets in the Old Testament. His prophetic book represents a transition from the exilic period to the post-exilic period in Jewish history. The name has been carried throughout generations, leaving an impact on various cultures, such as those in the Middle East and Europe.
data.spiritual_significance: The Hebrew etymology of the name Ezechiel reveals its deep spiritual resonance. It means "God will strengthen, help; Yahweh is strong," underscoring faith and reliance on the divine power. Ezechiel embodies the idea of devotion, resilience, and unwavering determination in the face of adversity. He serves as a reminder that even in the darkest times, God's strength and presence can help us overcome the most daunting challenges.

historical_references.reference: Born in the 6th century BCE in Judea, Ezechiel was a prophet who is best known for his visions of the future.
